# React Text Game

> React Text Game is a type-safe React engine for interactive fiction, story passages, maps, reactive entities, and persistent saves.

Prefer Markdown when reading the documentation. No agent skill installation is required.
Every HTML documentation page has a "View as Markdown" link and a <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> pointing to its Markdown source.
Most guide and API detail URLs support removing the trailing slash and appending .md, for example /core-concepts/ becomes /core-concepts.md.
The home page is /intro.md; section overview pages use /index.md, for example /api/core/ becomes /api/core/index.md.
Follow the explicit Markdown links below or on each HTML page when the paths differ. Request those .md URLs directly; requesting an HTML URL with Accept: text/markdown does not select the Markdown version.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://reacttextgame.dev/intro.md): Packages, architecture, and a minimal passage.
- [Installation](https://reacttextgame.dev/getting-started.md): Set up the libraries.
- [First game with core and UI](https://reacttextgame.dev/first-game/core+ui.md): Build a game with the supplied React renderers.
- [First game with core only](https://reacttextgame.dev/first-game/core.md): Build your own renderer.
- [Core concepts](https://reacttextgame.dev/core-concepts.md): Entities, passages, navigation, and state.
- [Side effects](https://reacttextgame.dev/side-effects.md): Keep passage rendering pure and mutate state in actions.

## Guides

- [Interactive maps](https://reacttextgame.dev/interactive-maps.md): Hotspots, coordinates, and decorative images.
- [Loading and splash screens](https://reacttextgame.dev/loading-and-splash-screens.md): Preloading and startup lifecycle.
- [Custom UI](https://reacttextgame.dev/custom-ui.md): Replace primitives and passage renderers.
- [MDX integration](https://reacttextgame.dev/mdx-integration.md): Author passages with Markdown and JSX.
- [Messenger](https://reacttextgame.dev/messenger.md): Persistent transcripts and unread tracking.
- [Messenger game tutorial](https://reacttextgame.dev/messenger-game.md): Build a chat-driven game.
- [Game clock](https://reacttextgame.dev/game-clock.md): In-fiction time and scheduling.
- [Internationalization](https://reacttextgame.dev/i18n.md): Translate game content and UI.
- [Saves](https://reacttextgame.dev/saves.md): Save slots, metadata, and import/export.
- [Save migrations](https://reacttextgame.dev/migrations.md): Version persisted game state.
- [Keep your saves valid](https://reacttextgame.dev/keep-saves-valid.md): Check save compatibility with the rtg CLI.
